Kinematics.name: Final Velocity
Kinematics.description: This equation helps you find the final velocity of an object when you know its initial velocity, acceleration, and the time it has been moving.

Kinematics.name: Displacement
Kinematics.description: You can use this to calculate how far an object has traveled, taking into account its starting velocity and the acceleration over time.

Dynamics.name: Newton's 2nd Law
Dynamics.description: This shows that the net force acting on an object is the product of its mass and acceleration.
